bagPolicy.summary: Reggies has no current bag restrictions for the Rock Club or Music Joint, but security may search your bag before you enter.
bagPolicy.quote: We currently do not have restrictions on bags

parking.summary: Reggies does not have a dedicated parking lot. Metered street parking is usually available nearby, and the meters are free after 10pm.
parking.quote: REGGIES does not have a dedicated parking lot.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Reggies. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Reggies has a bar and grill, and food can be ordered online. In the Rock Club, only fans of legal drinking age with a valid ID get a wristband to drink, and once Rock Club doors open it is cash only.
concessions.quote: Once Rock Club doors are open it is cash only.

accessibility.summary: The Music Joint and Comedy Shack offer plenty of accessible seating. For Rock Club shows, email info@reggieslive.com to arrange accommodations.
accessibility.quote: please email us at info@reggieslive.com to arrange accommodations.

reEntry.summary: Reggies hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is on the 2nd floor above the Music Joint and is open 11am to midnight daily. Day-of-show tickets are sold until venue doors open, and if you forget a printed ticket, bring a valid ID that matches the name on the will call list. Check the listing for age limits; the Music Joint is 21+ unless minors are with a legal guardian, and photos of IDs are not accepted.

gates.summary: Reggies hasn't published doors and entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
